email_subject: Application - AI Automation Builder at Introw
email_body:
Hi Simon,

I saw Introw is hiring an AI Automation Builder to free up every team from busywork. That's exactly the kind of work I do: I built an AI job-search assistant that collects postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter. It's a working example of marketing automation that saves me hours every week.

I also built and launched PupSmart, an AI dog-care app on Google Play with a potty predictor and toxic-food scanner, and Rebound, a fitness app that syncs with a smartwatch and smart scale. I use Claude and ChatGPT daily to get real work done, and I pick up new tools fast.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so the daily trip to your Ghent office is no problem. I'd love to talk about how I can help Introw scale.

Best,
Baver Ok

I built and launched my own AI dog-care app on Google Play and an AI job-search assistant, so I know how to take a problem, build a simple solution and hand it over. I am commercial, careful with data, and eager to learn in a fast-growing team.
